name: South Orange Recreation Summer Day Camp
operator_name: South Orange Department of Recreation and Cultural Affairs
description_short: Seven week village day camp in Meadowland Park for South Orange residents entering pre-K through grade 8, with sports, crafts, games and two swim times a week. Full day and half day options; only South Orange residents can register.
notes: Open to South Orange residents only. Half day 9 am to 1 pm, full day 9 am to 4 pm, extended hours from 8 am and until 5 pm. 2026 registration opened January 11 for Recreation members and January 13 for general registration. Fees are in the village's Rec1 catalog, which needs a login.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 camp page. ZIP is from the village offices address in the page footer (76 South Orange Avenue, South Orange, NJ 07079); the page names Meadowland Park as the camp site but gives no street address
